run_beir_evaluation: run a BEIR benchmark evaluation on a Contriever retriever model with a specified dataset
run_biencoder_evaluation: run a BEIR evaluation using separate query and document encoders loaded from a checkpoint
run_multiple_prompts_evaluation: run a BEIR evaluation with multiple instructional prompts to compare retrieval performance
run_evaluation_with_saved_embeddings: run a BEIR evaluation by loading precomputed embeddings from disk instead of recomputing
run_evaluation_with_normalization: run a BEIR evaluation with query and document embedding normalization enabled
